title: Zoe 'Zilgit' and Ghostu-Spider SZN: The Rookie Who Came In Swinging at the Champions
body: Every league eventually gets the newcomer who refuses to act like one, and in 2026 the Buckaroo Football League got Zoe. It's her first season of fantasy football and the league expanded to eight teams to make room for Ghostu-Spider SZN. In Week 1, the draw was Kaushal, owner of Buckaroo Bowls I and II, and Zoe hung 129.6 on Habibsters. That's still her career-best week, and it was her career-opening week, which is a very efficient way to tell the league you've arrived.

Seven weeks in, Ghostu-Spider SZN sits at 3-4 with 660.4 points, about 94 a week. That's a respectable number for anyone, never mind a rookie. The low point was Week 5, a 69.1 dud that happened to come against Jordan. Losing to your fiancé is one thing; losing to JMoney, a man who openly admits he's here for the spreadsheets, is the kind of result that gets brought up at every dinner until next September.

The head-to-head ledger tells a strange story. Z Squared is a perfect 3-0 against Kaushal, Sonny and Alan: two Buckaroo Bowl champions and the league's resident villain, Philliberto himself. She's 0-4 against Ramon, Randy, Jordan and Mekhi, so the giants fall and the rest of the field somehow doesn't. The Randy loss stings more than most, because the lone Wisconsinite in a league of Chicago guys now has to hear about it from the loudest Bears fan in the group.

As a manager, Zilgit works the waiver wire and leaves the trade market alone. She has made 7 pickups and zero trades so far. That could be patience, or it could be that after sitting in a few Randy negotiations she decided trading in this league isn't worth the trouble. Either way, she has built this roster herself, one waiver claim at a time.

For now the projections have Ghostu-Spider SZN's title odds at 0%, so Buckaroo Bowl IV will probably have to wait. But nobody else's first-year résumé includes wins over the commissioner-champion, the two-time champ and Phillibert. Midwest winters build character, and rookie seasons like this one usually build rivals. The rest of the league should know she'll be back next year with a full season of notes.
